name: gemini-3-5-flash-lite
_quality_basis: same Flash-Lite tier as gemini-3.1-flash-lite (Google lists it as the cost-effective variant); not benchmarked by 148AI; added as a second capacity pool after HTTP 503 high-demand answers on 2026-10-07

name: gemini-3-8-flash
_timeout_basis: bld_78e26994 (2026-10-08): a repair call timed out at the 120 s default; 16k output tokens need longer
_output_basis: model output limit 65,536 (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash, checked 2026-10-08); rehearsal 37840698696 truncated JSON at the 12k request cap once skills made the code longer
_thinking_basis: reasoning_effort=low -> thinking_level low (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai, checked 2026-10-09). Paid builds 2026-10-09: default thinking consumed the output allowance (finish_reason=length, truncated repair JSON); thinking tokens are billed as output.

name: openai-gpt-6-luna
_quality_basis: OpenAI's low-cost tier; not benchmarked by 148AI. GPT-6-class chat completions reject max_tokens and a non-default temperature (api=openai_reasoning)

name: openai-gpt-6-1-sol
_quality_basis: OpenAI flagship tier; not benchmarked by 148AI. Reasoning tokens count against max_completion_tokens; effort low keeps room for the answer

name: anthropic-claude-sonnet-5-5
_quality_basis: Anthropic's current mid tier; not benchmarked by 148AI. Native Messages API (the OpenAI layer is documented as not for production); non-default temperature returns 400, so none is sent
_thinking_basis: Sonnet 5.5 runs adaptive thinking at high effort by default; founder build bld_ca727ba7 (2026-11-08) spent all 16,384 output tokens on thinking and returned no text (codegen) and cut the architect JSON at 6,000. between_tools is the documented way to turn off up-front thinking on this model ("disabled" returns 400): https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/whats-new-sonnet-5-5 (checked 2026-11-08)
_output_basis: Sonnet 5.5 max output is 128K on the Messages API (platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/overview, checked 2026-11-09). bld_624610bc: codegen was cut at the old 16,384 cap (finish_reason=max_tokens at 31,472 chars). 64K keeps a single call bounded.
